title: LEBGen: An LLM-Enhanced Bayesian Network Framework for Few-Shot Travel Survey Data Generation
abstract: arXiv:2609.08288v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Travel survey data are essential for transportation planning and travel behavior analysis, yet collecting large-scale representative samples is costly and time-consuming. A practical alternative is to generate synthetic survey records from a few-shot sample. However, such samples provide incomplete coverage of heterogeneous traveler groups and insufficient evidence for recovering the complex dependencies between demographic characteristics and travel behavior. Existing approaches have complementary limitations. Probabilistic generative models such as Bayesian networks (BNs) offer explicit distributional control, but structures learned from few-shot samples may omit meaningful dependencies or retain spurious ones. Large language models (LLMs) can help address these difficulties in BN structure learning by providing behavioral knowledge that complements the limited statistical evidence. We therefore propose LEBGen, an LLM-enhanced BN frame

translated_title: LEBGen：一种用于少样本出行调查数据生成的大语言模型增强贝叶斯网络框架
translated_abstract: 出行调查数据对于交通规划和出行行为分析至关重要，然而收集大规模代表性样本成本高昂且耗时。一种实用的替代方法是从少样本中生成合成的调查记录。然而，此类少样本对异质性出行者群体的覆盖不完整，且在恢复人口统计特征与出行行为之间复杂依赖关系方面证据不足。现有方法存在各自互补的局限性。以贝叶斯网络（BN）为代表的概率生成模型提供了明确的分布控制能力，但从少样本中学习到的网络结构可能会遗漏有意义的依赖关系或保留虚假的依赖关系。大语言模型（LLM）可以通过提供行为知识来补充有限的统计证据，从而帮助解决贝叶斯网络结构学习中的这些困难。因此，我们提出了LEBGen，一个由大语言模型增强的贝叶斯网络框架（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文提出LEBGen框架，利用大语言模型提供的行为知识增强贝叶斯网络结构学习，克服少样本出行调查数据覆盖不足和依赖关系恢复困难的局限，实现高质量的合成出行调查数据生成。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LEBGen, an LLM-enhanced Bayesian network framework that leverages LLM-provided behavioral knowledge to improve BN structure learning from few-shot travel survey samples, enabling high-quality synthetic travel survey data generation despite incomplete sample coverage and limited statistical evidence.
